project_info.theme: MUYANG minimalist 10-page flagship ecommerce KV system
project_info.color_palette: Warm cream, oatmeal, champagne, moss gray-green, muted gold

main_subject.detail: A coherent 9:16 flagship-store visual system built from an approved MUYANG product reference, beginning with logo generation and then hero, lifestyle, collage, detail, color, size-guide and care pages. The preview image shows a beige stroller example, while the source prompt specifically describes a champagne silk slip dress system.
main_subject.style: Clean high-end minimalist ecommerce campaign with bilingual Chinese-English typography

composition_elements.text: MUYANG; 3-SECOND FAST FOLD; One-hand Operation; One-touch Fold; Effortless; TRY NOW
items: Top left: small approved MUYANG logo on each page.
Hero: centered approved product on warm cream studio field with large bilingual title.
Detail pages: macro material, construction, silhouette and feature close-ups.
Information pages: restrained color/material board, size/parameter grid and care guidance.
CTA: rounded glass-like pill button at lower right or lower edge.

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Clean warm gradients, gentle realistic product shadows, ample negative space and consistent refined bilingual type treatment

assets.name: MUYANG logo
assets.usage: Generate once and reuse at upper left of every page.

assets.name: exact product reference
assets.source: approved packshots and technical product information
assets.usage: Preserve actual product silhouette, materials, features and colorways; replace the preview stroller or source dress with the requested real product.

assets.name: bilingual typography and page system
assets.usage: Keep Chinese-English hierarchy and selected glass/relief text treatment consistent.

assets.name: feature, size and care data
assets.usage: Populate claims, dimensions, care instructions and CTA without fabrication.

prompt_instructions: Source mismatch: the preview is a stroller, while the source prompt describes a silk slip dress; attach the intended actual product before rendering.
Generate logo first, then apply the same approved logo and typography system across all ten pages.
Never invent product claims, dimensions, discount details or Chinese copy.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: 基于我给的产品图，梳理产品卖点/参数要点，然后给我输出一套统一旗舰店极简KV系统（9:16），最后生成10张详情页的完整提示词（中英双语、干净大气、至少5张细节特写），先单独生成Logo，用于后续每张海报左上角，其中中文排版风格需要统一，比如玻璃效果、3d浮雕效果，或者其他效果。 00、LOGO生成：极简高端时尚品牌logo，矢量风格，干净几何形；品牌名 MUYANG，细线圆形徽章内含单支精致叶枝，深苔灰绿色 #2F3A33 搭配温暖米白 #F3EFE6，宽松高端衬线 MUYANG，下方小字 沐阳，无渐变、无阴影、无3D、无样机、无水印。 Then produce a unified ten-page 9:16 product-detail KV system including hero, lifestyle scene, multi-scene collage, at least five material/construction detail close-ups, product color/model board, size/parameter guide and final care/trust page. The source example specifies a champagne/cream satin spaghetti-strap silk slip dress with a consistent MUYANG logo, clean warm cream/oatmeal lighting, bilingual Chinese-English titles, rounded glass-like information cards and pill CTAs. Preserve the approved product reference exactly and keep Chinese typography consistent across every page.
prompt.negative_prompt: unapproved product substitution, fabricated product claims, inconsistent logo, messy bilingual text, clutter, heavy texture, watermark, low resolution
